_about: Official sources watched for changes to the Bulgarian admission rules (app/services/admission_rule_watch.py, docs/ADMISSION_POINTS.md → Keeping rules current). `families` lists every rule family under frontend/src/admission/rules/bg with the dates (MM-DD of the year applications run) by which next campaign's file must exist and a provisional one must be confirmed.

targets.title: Sofia council sessions
targets.why: Each session page lists the adopted decisions; the kindergarten and first-grade ordinances are amended by council decision (Реш. 200 and 201 of 12.03.2026). Catchment changes for first grade also pass through here (they need a new catchment snapshot, backend/scripts/build_sofia_catchments.py). The page is per council mandate: the next mandate starts after the October 2027 elections, when this URL must be updated (the watcher reports it as unreadable once no sessions are listed).

targets.title: Sofia public consultations
targets.why: Draft amendments to municipal ordinances are published here for 30 days before the council votes, so this is the earliest warning.

targets.title: Sofia municipality news
targets.why: The municipality announces court rulings on its admission ordinances here (for example the 27.05.2026 first-grade ruling) and the yearly schedules. This is how the ВАС appeal on the first-grade address choice (Реш. 201/2026) is followed: the court portals cannot be read automatically.

targets.title: ИСОДЗ admission calendar
targets.why: The official kindergarten and first-grade schedule. The next campaign's schedule is published by 5 January; it fills the `schedule` of the rule files and is the cue to confirm provisional ones.

targets.title: National public consultations
keywords: организация на дейностите в училищното образование
targets.why: Every draft national act, including МОН's amendments to Наредба № 10 (8th-grade score formulas, the national first-grade template), is published here for consultation before adoption. mon.bg itself is behind a Cloudflare check that GitHub's runners cannot pass.

bg/sofia/kindergarten.note: the ИСОДЗ calendar (kg.sofia.bg) and council decisions amending the Наредба за прием на деца (usually February or March).

bg/sofia/grade_1.note: the ИСОДЗ calendar (kg.sofia.bg), council decisions amending the first-grade ordinance, and the ВАС appeal on the address choice (Реш. 201/2026).

bg/grade_8.note: Наредба № 10 (чл. 55–60) for amendments, and the МОН order with the 8th-grade schedule (usually January).
